title: Convergence in Science, Divergence in Religion: Calibrated Framing Differences Across Wikipedia's Language Editions

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring framing divergence of culturally loaded concepts (e.g., religion, politics, pop culture) across different language editions of Wikipedia using baseline-calibrated sentence embedding distances.
Comparing the semantic distance of concept representations across 20 different Wikipedia language editions to quantify cross-lingual framing differences and information gaps.
